# /council (Autonomous Submodule)

Convene the Council of AI multi-agent decision framework within this autonomous micro-app.

Based on *The Council of AI: A Multi-Agent Prompting Framework for Better Decision-Making* by Marius Silo ([Silotech.xyz](https://medium.com/@Silotech.xyz/the-council-of-ai-a-multi-agent-prompting-framework-for-better-decision-making-8e7569c10584)).

## When to use
- Assessing new submodule capabilities, routes, or schema changes.
- Checking for invariant violations (Invariant 6: Zero parent cross-imports, Invariant 5: Dedicated Turso DB).
- Running `./run.sh council "<topic>"`.
